component.name: MIGA
component.summary: End-to-end encrypted messenger with no account

description.p: MIGA (Make Internet Great Again) is an end-to-end encrypted text messenger. There is no phone number and no e-mail address: your identity is a key pair that is created and kept on your device.

ul.li: Messages are encrypted on your device and can only be read by the person you write to
Reply to a message, delete messages for yourself or for everyone
Link another device or share your contact with a QR code, with a built-in scanner

description.p: MIGA is an early release and has not been security-audited yet. Deleting a message for everyone cannot undo a screenshot or a copy kept by a modified app.

screenshot.caption: Share your contact as a QR code

ul.li: Reply to a message: the quote travels inside the encrypted message
Delete messages for yourself or for everyone
Delete and block contacts; the block list syncs to linked devices
QR codes to link a device or share a contact, with an in-app scanner
